title: Campaign concept and copy
brief: Create a campaign line and supporting copy for Northstar's run receipts. Audience: engineering managers. Supported proof: inputs, outputs, costs, verdicts, follow-ups, and comparisons. Avoid fear, autonomy, and guaranteed-safety claims.

A.content: Headline: Unlock the Future of AI Transparency. Body: Northstar gives modern engineering teams greater visibility into agent activity through clear receipts, collaborative review, and flexible workflow support. CTA: Transform Your AI Workflow Today.

B.content: Campaign line: The run is finished. The review starts here. Support: Northstar puts the input, output, cost, verdict, and next action in one receipt—so an agent handoff arrives as work your team can inspect, compare, and decide on. CTA: Review a receipt.
